name: Local aging help in Louisiana (Eldercare Locator)
description: A national public service that connects older adults and caregivers to their local aging agency and services.
next_step: Give the ZIP code; ask for the local aging agency, meals, transportation, caregiver support and home services.
constraints: A national referral line, not a local intake office. Confirm services and eligibility with the local agency.

name: Louisiana long-term-care ombudsman
organization: National Long-Term Care Ombudsman Resource Center
description: Ombudsmen advocate for residents of nursing homes and assisted living facilities.
